verdict.rationale: Dynadot's transfer pages confirm transfer-in exists and mention '1-year renewal' and 'free privacy' as incentives, implying some handling of registration term, but there is no documentation of the EPP/auth-code process itself, no status-tracking detail, and no explicit cost breakdown for transfers. Missing for 10: EPP/auth-code flow explanation, transfer status tracking documentation, itemized transfer cost, and clear statement of what happens to remaining registration time.
